name: On Lost Crisitunities, Vanishing Postsoviet and Decolonization of Thinking, Being and Perception.
headline: On Lost Crisitunities, Vanishing Postsoviet and Decolonization of Thinking, Being and Perception.
description: The author shows the decolonial option as a pluriverse wherein even the colonial itself and the legacy of imperialism must be interrogated according to specific contours and locales.
